ACT XI OF 1975
ACT XI OF 1975
LABOUR LAWS
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An Act further to
amend certain laws relating to the welfare of workers
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 25th January, 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 25th January 1975, and is hereby
published for general information:-
THE SCHEDULE
1. THE WORKMEN'S COMPENSATION
ACT, VIII OF 1923.
1. For the words "High
Court", whenever occurring, the word "Tribunal" shall be
substituted.
2. In section 2, in subsection
(1), after clause (1), the following now clause shall be inserted, namely :-
"(11) "Tribunal"
has the same meaning as in the Industrial Relations Ordinance, 1969 (XXIII of
1969) ;".
3. In section 30, after
subsection (3), the following new subsection shall be added, namely :-
"(4) All appeals under this
section, and all questions under section 27, pending before any High Court
immediately before the commencement of the Labour Laws (Amendment) Act, 1975,
shall, on such commencement, stand transferred to, and be disposed of by, the
Tribunal within whose jurisdiction the cause of action to which the appeal
relates or, as the case may be the question arose.".
4. In section 35, in subsection
(1), for the words "Central Government" the words "Federal
Government" shall be substituted.
2. THE FACTORIES ACT, XXV OF
1934.
In section 60, in clause (6), in
sub-clause (i), for the word and figure "and 48" the commas, figures,
letters and word, ",48, 49H and 491" shall be substituted.
3. THE PAYMENT OF WAGES ACT,
IV OF 1936.
1. In section 1, in subsection
(3), for the words "Central Government" the words "Federal
Government" shall be substituted.
2. In section 17,-
(a) in subsection (1), for the
words "District Court" the words, commas, figures and brackets
"Labour Court constituted under the Industrial Relations Ordinance, 1969
(XXIII of 1969), within whose jurisdiction the cause of action to which the
appeal relates arose" shall be substituted ; and
(b) after subsection (1) amended
as aforesaid, the following new subsection shall be inserted, namely :-
"(1-A) All appeals pending
before any District Court under this section immediately before the
commencement of the Labour Laws (Amend ment) Act, 1975, shall, on such
commencement, stand transferred to, and be disposed of by, the Labour Court
within whose jurisdiction the cause of action to which the appeal relates
arose.".
4. THE COMPANIES PROFITS (WORKERS' PARTICIPATION) ACT,
XII OF 1968.
For the words "Central
Government" wherever occurring, the words Federal Government" shall
be substituted and shall be deemed to have been so substituted on the
fourteenth day of August 1973.
5. THE WORKERS' CHILDREN (EDUCATION) ORDINANCE, XI OF
1972.
In section 5, for the full-stop
at the end a colon shall be substituted and thereafter the following proviso
shall be added, namely :-
"Provided that the amount of
the cess shall be held in a separate account and shall be expended only for the
purposes of this Ordinance.".
6. THE NEWSPAPER EMPLOYEES (CONDITIONS OF SERVICE) ACT,
LVIII of 1973.
After section 23, the following
new section shall be inserted and shall be deemed to have been so inserted on
the 14th day of August 1973, namely :-
"23-A. Continuation of
powers.-The powers conferred by this Act on the Federal Government shall, as
from the fourteenth day of August 1973, continue to be exercised by the Federal
Government.".

Short title, extent and commencement

ACT XI OF 1975
ACT XI OF 1975
LABOUR LAWS
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An Act further to
amend certain laws relating to the welfare of workers
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 25th January, 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 25th January 1975, and is hereby
published for general information:-
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Labour Laws (Amendment) Act,
1975.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of certain laws
